world_selection: Same preselected fixture as both typed-map Hermes runs, no resampling.
initial_memory: Fresh original GenericAgent memory/SOP baseline extracted from the verified native archive; no previous trial or Hermes experience.
conditions: 20-task retained main stream and 19 current-task baseline-memory probes at the same actual retained-history checkpoints
analysis: all task outcomes and weighted ordered trace graphs
type-level actual delivered feedback, same-type transfer to previously unvisited physical stations, and inference separately
self-generated memory changes and actual delivery before the first branch choice
paired operation/distance differences with game failures and unreached stages retained
comparison_scope: Same benchmark/world/model alias and game/call/wall budgets; each native agent generates its own history and keeps its native context/memory configuration. One-world pilot, not an agent ranking.
recovery: only identified infrastructure failures, all attempts preserved; game failures never rerun; at most 9 starts and 3 at an unchanged valid checkpoint
native_context_policy: Preserve GA 50000 and Hermes 64000 native context configurations; do not patch native memory or loops.
analysis_carriers: GA native global_mem*.txt, self-authored SOP files, and actual native tool/model delivery are audited separately.
